title: Arc 4/5: make lore check validate that a modeline target resolves
summary: Endorsed for closure by OPAG-296; a gate about schema FILES that says nothing about pointers INTO them.
description: schemaDriftFindings has three conditions -- stale, missing, orphaned -- all about .lore/schemas/*.json, and a null committed yields no findings at all. Nothing anywhere validates that a document's line-1 yaml-language-server modeline points at a file that exists. Prove it both ways per the fleet rule: red on a deliberate dangling pointer with the RIGHT error, green on a clean tree, other jobs green on both SHAs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A document whose modeline target does not exist is reported by lore check
A clean tree stays green -- measured as a separate run, not inferred
The failing run's log shows the dangling-modeline error specifically, not an unrelated non-zero exit
A bundle with no .lore/schemas/ directory at all produces NO findings, matching schemaDriftFindings' existing absence-is-not-drift rule
Mutation-tested: the new assertion is separable and a predicted subset reddens
